scope: Independent review of actual arbitrary-family affine residual regularity, ridge Green, normal-point uniqueness, and angle-weighted fourth-radius ridge coefficients.
findings: AffineResidualRegularity proves genuine ordinary local finite regularity by excluding finitely many affine null sets. Every retained coordinate has coefficient one because all conditioned indices are excluded; the second residual slack excludes the additionally selected index as well. All normal vectors may be zero or dependent.

GenericPairGreen expands the true bisector/difference shifted levels into those affine combinations. The retained set excludes exactly the selected pair and hence satisfies the affine supplier without any full-family rank condition.

EdgeFourthBounds derives the angle bound theta <= (pi/2)*chord from the actual arccos angle and Jordan sine inequality, including angular endpoints. The signed norm-square-minus-two coefficient is then paid by the genuine fourth-radius rectangle fiber with constant 6144*pi*exp(3/2), with no inverse angular gap.

NormalPointUnique proves that two actual points in the same original-normal span with the same supporting levels are equal: their difference lies in that span and its inner functional kills all generators and therefore itself. No chosen frame, full basis, or desired point equality is assumed.

RidgeGreen defines the actual half ordered pair sum with its true two-dimensional normal Gaussian density and all remaining hard inequalities. Under ordinary local residual regularity, the actual pair signed-section Green theorem gives Leading minus Third. The generic affine regularity supplies this identity at volume-almost-every threshold for arbitrary fixed dependent unit normals.
qualifications: The reviewer did not author these five sources. Their imported LocalPartials, LocalFiniteThreshold, PairSectionTrace and spherical supporting modules authored by this reviewer are disclosed dependencies and are not independently re-reviewed by this record.

The packet supplies actual signed ridge Green and geometric coefficient estimates, not the final averaged J_e or full matrix estimate. The generic threshold conclusion is explicitly volume-almost-everywhere.
